levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Skips one or more of the four reset steps (clear, wipe, gather, safety scan).

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Completes all four reset steps in order.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Completes all four steps in order and explains why clearing the surface has to happen before wiping it.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Cannot name a specific item looked at during the safety scan, such as a stove knob or appliance switch.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Names at least one specific stove knob or appliance looked at, without touching it, during the safety scan.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Names more than one specific item looked at and explains the specific hazard each one presents.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Sets out items not on the list, or misses items that were on the list.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Sets out exactly the items on the list, nothing more or less.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Sets out exactly the list items and notices out loud when something is missing before starting.

lookFors: Clutter is returned to a specific spot, not pushed into a single pile.
The safety scan happens as a distinct last step before the learner calls the reset finished.
The learner describes the safety scan as look-only and never reports touching a stove knob or appliance switch.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
